MAT=np.array([[int(v) for v in r.split()] for r in B62.split("\n")],float); IDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAS)}
def enc(s): return np.array([IDX.get(c,0) for c in s])
def nwmap(s1,s2,go=-11.,ge=-1.):
    a=enc(s1); b=enc(s2); n,m=len(a),len(b); NEG=-1e9
    Mx=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    Pm=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); Px=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); Py=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    Mx[0,0]=0; Ix[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(n); Px[1:,0]=1; Iy[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(m); Py[0,1:]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        row=MAT[a[i-1],b]; st=np.vstack([Mx[i-1,:-1],Ix[i-1,:-1],Iy[i-1,:-1]])
        k=st.argmax(0); Mx[i,1:]=st[k,np.arange(m)]+row; Pm[i,1:]=k
        c0=Mx[i-1,1:]+go; c1=Ix[i-1,1:]+ge; kk=c1>c0; Ix[i,1:]=np.where(kk,c1,c0); Px[i,1:]=np.where(kk,1,0)
        Mi=Mx[i]; Iyi=Iy[i]; Pyi=Py[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            x0=Mi[j-1]+go; x1=Iyi[j-1]+ge
            if x1>x0: Iyi[j]=x1; Pyi[j]=2
            else: Iyi[j]=x0; Pyi[j]=0
    i,j=n,m; stt=int(np.argmax([Mx[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); mp={}
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if stt==0 and i>0 and j>0: mp[i]=(j,s2[j-1]); stt=Pm[i,j]; i-=1; j-=1
        elif stt==1 and i>0: mp[i]=(None,'-'); stt=Px[i,j]; i-=1
        elif stt==2 and j>0: stt=Py[i,j]; j-=1
        elif i>0: mp[i]=(None,'-'); i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return mp
def useq(acc): return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")

def show(mp,o1,o2,s1,s2,ps,lab):

        j,aa=mp.get(p-o1,(None,'-'))
        print(f"   {s1[p-1]}{p}  ->  {aa}{(j+o2) if j else '-'}")
